# LED Signs Australia

> LED Signs Australia designs and makes custom LED and 3D signage in Australia, based in Newcastle, NSW. Products are made to order: customers send an enquiry, receive a free design mock-up and a formal quote, and there is no payment or commitment required to enquire.

Contact: phone +61 481 308 955, email info@ledsignsaustralia.com.au

## Products

- [3D Cut Letters](https://ledsignsaustralia.com.au/3d-cut-letters.html): Custom 3D cut letters for business and home signage. Customers choose their text, style and finish, then send an order enquiry. Delivery or pickup available.
- [3D Illuminated Letters](https://ledsignsaustralia.com.au/3d-illuminated-letters.html): LED-lit 3D letters for shopfronts and interiors. Enquire for a free mock-up and quote.
- [Light Box Signs](https://ledsignsaustralia.com.au/light-box.html): Custom illuminated light box signs. Enquire for a free mock-up and quote.
- [Home Plates](https://ledsignsaustralia.com.au/home-plates.html): Custom house number and name plates. Free design and quote.

## How ordering works

- Fill in the enquiry form on any product page (name, email and phone number are required).
- LED Signs Australia replies with a free mock-up, material advice and a formal quote.
- Pricing is per job and depends on size, materials and lighting, so there are no fixed catalogue prices.
